title: narcissus telamonius
intro: Narcissus telamonius, commonly known as the Daffodil, is a perennial plant species in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Narcissus telamonius include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids such as galantamine, and other compounds that have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular protective effects.
